title: Independent brackish aquifer below the Osiris Shaft

tellings.quote: So, there's a very independent aquifer located directly below the Osiris shaft that is not connected to the Nile River.

plain: The Osiris Shaft is a deep shaft cut into the rock of the Giza Plateau in Egypt, the high ground where the great pyramids stand. A researcher named Jeffrey Drum, speaking on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, says that right below this shaft sits a body of underground water that is completely separate from the Nile River. If true, the water under the shaft would come from somewhere other than the river, which matters to people who think the site was built around water for a reason.
